title: Global oriented N-point normal forms,exact alignment gates and the nonproper homological Seifert barrier

newly_cached_primary_context.role: Full primary HTML read at Sections1-4,including Theorems2.2/2.3/3.2/3.3 and proofs. Its isolated-finite-singularity setup explicitly permits unrestricted singularities at infinity;the dimension-two splice results are not imported.

newly_imported_proved_external_statement.statement: For polynomial maps with isolated finite singularities,the positive global fibre homology is the injective direct sum of variation images of the relative homology of finite and infinite Milnor pieces.
newly_imported_proved_external_statement.application: All native models,explicit normal forms and required cotangent potentials have finitely many Morse singularities. KA and JZ give only H3=Z^N and an integral basis of N finite Morse cycles. Thus every positive-degree relative homology group of an infinity piece is zero. No absence or topological triviality of the pieces is inferred.

newly_imported_proved_external_statement.statement: The regular-link Seifert form exists in this nonproper setup and is block triangular in the variation decomposition,with local blocks and zero cross terms between pieces at the same value.
newly_imported_proved_external_statement.application: Use complex dimension n=4 and middle degree q=3. All nonzero blocks come from finite Morse pieces;each has the same rank-one sign. At collided values the theorem gives the required zero cross terms directly.

newly_imported_proved_external_statement.statement: Seifert cross blocks at distinct values are determined by off-diagonal homological monodromy;the intersection form is L minus its graded transpose.
newly_imported_proved_external_statement.application: KA gives identity monodromy on the entire integral H3. Hence all cross blocks vanish. In degree3 the graded transpose sign is +1,so the Seifert matrix is epsilon I_N and the intersection matrix is zero. No tameness or isolated-infinity hypothesis is inserted.
